description: Closed list of fetch targets for apex-tech-watch. Edit this file to add/remove sources without touching SKILL.md.

sources.summarize_prompt: Extract releases from the last 7 days: version, key new features, breaking changes, deprecations, new hook/skill/MCP primitives. Return up to 5 short bullets. If no releases in the window, say 'no releases this week' on a single line.

Extract posts from the last 7 days that affect API users or Claude Code: model releases, deprecations, new capabilities, pricing changes. Skip marketing/research posts. Up to 5 bullets. If no relevant posts, say 'no relevant news this week'.
Extract API changelog entries from the last 7 days. Flag breaking changes vs additive changes. Up to 5 bullets. If empty, say so.
List the currently-recommended Claude models (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) with their model IDs and any deprecation warnings. One short block per family.

Summarize Anthropic's current Claude prompting best-practices guidance relevant to apex agent/orchestrator prompts: prompt structure, system prompts, tool-use, chain-of-thought, output control, and model-specific tips. Up to 6 short actionable bullets. Call out anything that changed vs prior general guidance; if the page is unchanged from a stable reference, say 'reference unchanged' on one line.
Top 5 results from the last 30 days. For each: title, URL, one-line takeaway. Filter out marketing pages and AI-generated SEO spam.
Top 5 results from the last 30 days that describe agent architecture / orchestration patterns relevant to apex (multi-agent, worktree isolation, self-reflection). Title, URL, one-line takeaway.

Extract TypeScript releases from the last 30 days: version, new compiler / type-system features (satisfies, const type params, decorators, narrowing improvements, etc.), breaking changes, deprecations. Up to 6 bullets. Always state the tag date of the most recent release listed so a stale snapshot is obvious. If no stable release in the last 30 days, widen to 60 days and report the most recent stable tag with its date, prefixed 'stale (>30d):'. If none within 60 days, fall back to the most recent RC/beta tag: name it, its date, and any notable new method or compiler flag, prefixed 'RC fallback:'. Only if there is no stable tag within 60 days and no RC/beta tag either, say 'no releases this month' on a single line.

Extract Next.js releases from the last 30 days: version, App-Router / RSC / Server-Action changes, new hooks or APIs, bundled React version, breaking changes. Up to 6 bullets. Include the React minor version each Next ships against so React-side method additions surface here too. If no stable release in the window, fall back to the most recent canary/RC tag (name it, its date, notable changes, prefixed 'RC fallback:'); only if none exists, say 'no releases this month'.

sources.query: typescript react next.js node bun best practices new patterns 2026
sources.summarize_prompt: Top 5 results from the last 30 days on modern TS / React / Next.js / Node-or-Bun patterns: new language features in use, idiomatic type-narrowing, server-component data fetching, runtime-perf tricks, lint/formatter shifts. For each: title, URL, one-line takeaway. Filter out marketing pages, AI-generated SEO spam, and tutorials older than 30 days reposted as 'new'.

Top 10 trending repos this week. Filter to AI / dev-tooling / agent-framework relevant entries. Return: repo (org/name), stars-this-week, one-line description. Skip cryptocurrency, gaming, generic UI starters.
